analysis.reasonEn: RSI exited oversold from 37.0 to 46.6 and is now consolidating in the neutral zone. MACD histogram improved from -10.4071 to -0.2961 but remains negative. A Higher Low pattern is forming with the 5-day low at 638.61 exceeding the 20-day low of 583.80. Trading volume is subdued at 0.45x the 5-day average. The overall market is in a 'lifeblood activated' phase, reducing plans. Awaiting CPI data.
